title: Research-ops (Tier-1 tooling): census of TRUE trial counts per subject/lever family across research/queue (hand + generated + LLM-authored units, incl. near-duplicates), compared with the n_comparisons each decision rule declares; reported weekly to programme-review
note: Filed 2026-11-18 by PRACTICE-REFRESH-20261118 (docs/research/practice-review-2026-11-18.md § R-G1). Principles M4/M5/R5 + R9 (new): practice and the LLM alpha-mining literature both say automated idea generators produce homogeneous, near-duplicate hypotheses (AlphaAgent S84 enforces an originality score against existing factors; Man AlphaGPT S83 forbids flipping a hypothesis after results). MEASURED 2026-11-18: research/queue holds 2,398 RQ units (1,994 done, 318 queued, 71 retired, 15 blocked); queue_replenish.py dedupes only by generated key; hand-authored units carry no overlap check; decision rules declare n_comparisons per unit, and only some disclose prior reads of the same class (e.g. RQ-20261117-43b6-03 'cumulative 7'). Build: group units by (subject, lever, harness, metric, holdout window), report per family the count of reads vs the max declared n, and list families where declared < counted. Feeds the M13 holdout ledger. Re-entry test: the first census record lands and programme-review cites it.
